title: POV: pied kingfisher, no perch needed

scenes.headline: POV: you're a pied kingfisher and the fish are far from any perch
No branch over the good water? No problem.
You just hover. Then dive. Then eat on the wing.
Pied kingfishers are the largest birds that can hover for long
scenes.body: And unlike other kingfishers, they swallow their fish in flight after plunging.

caption:
Perches are optional when you can hover.

Pied kingfishers form communal roosts at certain times of year, and you can find them over lakes and rivers across India and Africa. This one was filmed at Queen Elizabeth National Park, Uganda.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Ceryle rudis).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: First-person POV text over our CC clip of a pied kingfisher scanning from a reed, paying off with its genuinely unusual hover-and-swallow-in-flight trick.
